subject: Monthly Report
summary: Vanillic acid obtained as the methyl ester has been found in "C" Turkish tobacco. Last month there was reported the isolation of a dithio-rotatory compound believed to be the amide of either 6-hydroxy-β-glangforquin acid or β-hydroxy-β-glangf-5-oxoginic acid. The identity of the amide remains unsettled, but examination obtained this month indicates it to be α-hydroxy-β-glangforquinamide.
experiment: A. The isolation and identification of methyl vanillate.
